issues: STRUCTURE: The feature has no entry point. The spec requires exactly one entry point, `index.ts`, which re-exports the feature's entire public API (Structure). Add an `index.ts` that re-exports `punch-card.ts`'s public API so nothing outside the feature needs to import internal files.

STRUCTURE: Types are not in a dedicated `<feature>-types.ts` file. The spec requires types to live in a dedicated `<feature>-types.ts` file; here the feature has no types at all, which is acceptable only if no types exist, but there is no types file at all — note this is a gap relative to the structural convention.

COHESION: The feature contains two unrelated capabilities. `punch-card.ts` (loyalty punches / free scoop logic) and `summer-promo.ts` (summer flavors banner) serve unrelated purposes, violating 'one capability per feature'. `summer-promo.ts` must be extracted into its own feature (with its own index.ts) or removed from the loyalty feature.

COHESION: `summer-promo.ts` is an orphaned file. The spec requires no orphaned files: every file must be reachable from `index.ts` through its import graph. Since there is no `index.ts` and nothing imports `summer-promo.ts`, it is unreachable.

LOGIC FILE NAMING: `punch-card.ts` is a noun-first name. The spec requires logic files to be verb-first kebab-case (e.g., `pick-winners.ts`), so `punch-card.ts` should be renamed to something like `count-punches.ts` or `track-punches.ts`. Also, the logic does not follow service conventions: the spec requires one exported `run`, Results over exceptions, and consumer-grade error messages; `punch-card.ts` exports `punchesFor`/`isFreeScoopEarned` and returns plain numbers/booleans rather than a Results-based `run` API.
result.reason: The loyalty cohort fails the feature-module conventions on nearly every axis: it has no index.ts entry point (the spec's central structural requirement), it bundles two unrelated capabilities, summer-promo.ts is orphaned, and the logic files do not follow the required service conventions (verb-first names, single `run` export, Results over exceptions).
